GO




--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartTimestamp, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY PeriodEndTimestamp DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary_WITH_DUP_20230519  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.PaymentCardStatementSummary;
